source: WTC 2025 map pack v2.3 as digitised by the layout viewer at https://labrador.dev/40k-layouts (accessed 2026-10-23). Board 60x44 inches, SVG coords: x right 0..60, y DOWN 0..44.
transform: Each listed piece is one half of the table. World point of a local feature coord (lx,ly): rot=rotation deg; dx=lx*cos(rot)-ly*sin(rot); dy=lx*sin(rot)+ly*cos(rot); world = flip ? (point.x - dx, point.y + dy) : (point.x + dx, point.y + dy). The other half: point' = (60-point.x, 44-point.y), rotation' = rotation-180, same flip, same feature. So every map has 12 pieces and is 180-degree symmetric about (30,22).

ruin3.note: WTC2024ThreeStoryRuin. footprint = ruin area; wall = L-shaped wall panel (outer edges of the L stand on footprint-local x-axis and y-axis, inset 0.86); floor = upper-floor L. Real height ~9.5in

ruin2.note: WTC2024TwoStoryRuin. Same footprint and L wall as ruin3; wall windows; real height ~5in; smaller upper floor
